body: I was just Temp Banned by MLGPorky for team spleefing, which I don't know what it is, and it sounds like some kind of bow thing and I wasn't using a bow at all. Please someone consider me innocent because this is no lie, and I am telling the truth.

title: Temp Banned for no reason?

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

We don't appeal valid temp-bans. 

Team spleefing is when you kill your teammates by breaking the blocks under them.

This appeal is Denied.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
